title: Normalized regular module comparison for inverse image and scalar extension
statement: Let g:T → T′ be a continuous map of topological spaces, A a commutative-ring sheaf on T′, B a commutative-ring sheaf on T, and t:g⁻¹A → B a ring-sheaf morphism. Write R(S) for the associated ring sheaf and unit R(S) for its regular module. There exists a B-linear isomorphism e:B tensor_{g⁻¹A} g⁻¹(unit R(A)) ≅ unit R(B), with the tensors sheafified. For every open V of T′ and a in A(V), the forward isomorphism takes the sheafification of 1 tensor η_Ab(a) over g⁻¹V to t(η_A(a)), where η_Ab is the abelian inverse-image unit and η_A the ring inverse-image unit. All constructions are the explicit inverse-image modules and sheafified scalar extensions of [def-pc-topological-inverse-image-module] and [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

source.place: Tags 008X and 008Y (inverse-image modules and adjunction); Tag 008A (scalar-extension adjunction)

proof.text: Compose the scalar-extension hom equivalence with the inverse-image module hom equivalence. Maps from the inverse-image regular module to the scalar restriction of N correspond to maps from the regular A-module to its direct image. Both adjunctions provide their canonical unit section formulas.

Maps from a regular module are compatible global sections. Precomposition by the map on opens is a bijection on sections: the map on opens is final, since inverse image preserves the terminal open. Combining these natural equivalences gives Hom(F,N) ≃ Hom(unit B,N). Set the forward map to the inverse image of the identity on unit B and the inverse map to the image of the identity on F. Naturality and the inverse identities of the equivalences show they are inverse. This is an elementary representable-functor argument.

The two adjunction formulas identify the value on the sheafification of 1 tensor η_Ab(a) with the adjunct at a. The adjunct sends 1 to 1, since the hom equivalence sends the forward isomorphism to the identity. Its A-linearity gives its value on a = a times 1 as t(η_A(a)) times 1, which equals t(η_A(a)). No nonzero ring or nonempty open is assumed.

proof_origin.place: Tags 008A and 008Y, specialized to the regular module and combined using its section universal property

mathlib_searches.query: Inverse image and extension of scalars preserve the regular sheaf module compatibly with the unit
Extension of scalars of the inverse image of the regular sheaf module is the regular module with unit compatibility
mathlib_searches.results: Returns regular scalar action, tilde modules and restrictScalars; no normalized isomorphism for the explicit inverse-image and scalar-extension constructions. Loogle for SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv finds the regular-module Hom/sections equivalence used in the proof.

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib PullbackFree treats its abstract pullback, not the explicit inverseImageModule/changeOfRings construction. AffineModuleTensorAlgebraQuasiCoherent has private unnormalized unit isomorphisms; no public normalized comparison. No blueprint match.

theorem inverseImageRegularExtension
    {T T' : TopCat.{u}} (g : T ⟶ T') (A : T'.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u})
    (B : T.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u}) (t : TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing g A ⟶ B) :
    ∃ e : changeOfRings.{u, u, u} t
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule g A (unit (𝓡 A))) ≅ unit (𝓡 B),
      ∀ (V : (Opens T')ᵒᵖ) (a : A.obj.obj V),
        e.hom.val.app ((Opens.map g).op.obj V)
          (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
            (changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} t
              (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule g A (unit (𝓡 A))))).app
                ((Opens.map g).op.obj V)
                ((1 : B.obj.obj ((Opens.map g).op.obj V)) ⊗ₜ[
                  (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing g A).obj.obj ((Opens.map g).op.obj V),
                  (t.hom.app ((Opens.map g).op.obj V)).hom]
                  (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
                    (Opens.map g) AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.grothendieckTopology T')
                    (Opens.grothendieckTopology T)).unit.app
                      ((toSheaf (𝓡 A)).obj (unit (𝓡 A)))).hom.app V a))) =
          (t.hom.app ((Opens.map g).op.obj V)).hom
            (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
              (Opens.map g) CommRingCat.{u} (Opens.grothendieckTopology T')
              (Opens.grothendieckTopology T)).unit.app A).hom.app V a)
